requirement: Make Playwright page navigation in end-to-end tests resilient to transient timeouts by retrying with exponential backoff, without hiding real errors.
skeleton: A NavigationTimeoutError and goto_with_retry validating attempts, looping over all but the last attempt with a timeout-only handler and exponential sleeps, then a final unguarded goto.
caption: A Playwright navigation helper, written in the standard library against a duck-typed page with a goto method and no third-party imports, that retries only navigation timeouts. NavigationTimeoutError is a plain Exception standing in for Playwright's timeout. goto_with_retry(page, url, *, attempts=3, base_delay=0.5, sleep=time.sleep) raises ValueError when attempts is below 1. For every attempt but the last it returns page.goto(url, wait_until=domcontentloaded) on success and on NavigationTimeoutError sleeps base_delay times two to the power of the retry index starting at zero. The final attempt calls goto the same way outside any handler, so its timeout propagates; other exceptions are never retried. The fixture asserts an immediate success without sleeping, exponential delays, the last timeout propagating after exactly the attempt count, unretried errors, a single attempt, and attempt validation.

constraints: Delays are base_delay doubled per retry

rationale.teaches: Retry inside range(1, attempts) catching only the timeout type, back off with base_delay times two to the retry index, and let the final call raise naturally.
rationale.why: Catching every exception hides real failures behind slow retries, constant delays hammer a struggling server, and an extra attempt makes suites take longer than their timeout budget.

ops.docstring: Retry Playwright page.goto on navigation timeouts with exponential backoff.

ops.source:
class NavigationTimeoutError(Exception):
    """Raised by the page when a navigation times out."""

candidates.why_wrong: One extra navigation is attempted and the first delay is halved.
Every retry waits the same base delay instead of backing off.
Non-timeout errors such as a bad URL are retried and swallowed.
Zero attempts still navigates once instead of raising ValueError.
Navigation waits for the full load event instead of domcontentloaded.
